item.title: Green Stocks on Jan 30: Pre-Budget Trade Sees Mixed Performance
item.description: As the stock market closed ahead of the Budget announcement, green stocks delivered a mixed performance. Shares of companies such as Acme Solar gained on the back of positive financial results, while NTPC Green fell more than 6% following reporting a loss in profit within its Q3 results. Vikram Solar and Sterling and Wilson also recorded gains of over 2%, along with Oswal Pumps, which rose more than 4% during the trading session. item.description: Tamil Nadu and Kerala have recently awarded large standalone Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) tenders, with tariffs reaching new benchmarks despite ongoing concerns around rising battery input costs, currency volatility, and supply-chain pressures. item.title: DGPC, Carbon Resources to Develop Up to 250 MW Renewable Projects in Bhutan
item.description: Bhutan’s renewable energy company Druk Green Power Corporation Limited (DGPC) has entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Kolkata-based Carbon Resources Private Limited (CRPL) to evaluate and pursue the development of renewable energy projects in Bhutan. item.title: Union Budget Increases VGF Support for BESS, Hikes PM Surya Ghar Allocations
item.description: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman on Saturday presented the Union Budget for 2026–27. While the budget speech did not explicitly spell out detailed spending plans for India’s solar sector, the accompanying budget documents indicated a stronger thrust towards the Centre’s flagship solar and energy storage schemes. item.title: RERC Clears New Intra-State Grid Connectivity Rules for Rajasthan
item.description: The Rajasthan Electricity Regulatory Commission (RERC) has now approved a new regulatory framework, bringing significant changes to how power generators and bulk consumers connect to the state grid. The new regulations are titled "Procedure for Grant of Connectivity to the Intra-State Transmission System (InSTS)". item.title: NTPC Renewable Energy Brings First 210 MW of 1.2 GW Khavda-II Solar Project Online
item.description: NTPC Renewable Energy Limited, a subsidiary of NTPC Green Energy Limited, has commissioned the first part of its 1.2 GW solar project in Gujarat. In a regulatory filing, the company said the first phase comprises 210 MW of the 1,200 MW Khavda-II Solar PV Project located in the state. The latest project takes NTPC Green Energy Limited Group's current commercial capacity to 8,478.25 MW. item.title: Tesla Plans To Make a 100 GW Solar Cell Foundry In The US
item.description: Elon Musk-led Tesla Inc. has announced a plan to foray into the business of solar cell manufacturing. Chairman of the firm Elon Musk revealed their new cleantech initiative plan with its investors in its earning call. As per the plan of the US-based electric vehicle and clean energy major, Tesla, Inc. has indicated plans to become a large-scale manufacturer of solar cells in the United States, with a long-term ambition of 100 GW per year of integrated solar cell production. item.title: India’s PSP Potential Touches 267 GW as Off-Stream Projects Gain Momentum
item.description: India has a very large potential for Pumped Storage Projects (PSPs) across both on-river and off-river schemes. At present, India’s pumped storage potential is estimated at around 267 GW, including 58 GW of on-stream PSPs and 209 GW of off-stream PSPs, a report from the Central Electricity Authority (CEA) said.
